SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK SOF-VD-08: SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition — ViewDefinition.select.unionAll. Test these items: unionAll 0..* combines all rows from branch selection structures, UNION ALL semantics preserve duplicate rows, branch column compatibility and missing-column behavior, nested unionAll recursion, unionAll branches combined with forEach, forEachOrNull, repeat, and nested select, where filters interact with branch generation according to their scope. For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. For SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition chunks, test parser validation, SQL generation, DuckDB execution, and official spec fixtures/examples relevant to the chunk.

When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.

issues.spec_citation: SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition v2.0.0 Select.unionAll; FHIR JSON representation empty-property rule
issues.evidence: Fresh probe .temp/qa/sof_vd08_skeptic_probe.py expected ParseError for present select.unionAll: [] but parse_view_definition accepted it and the dataclass represented it identically to an absent unionAll. Actual: no error. Expected: present unionAll must contain at least one Select branch or be omitted.
issues.root_cause: _parse_select() reused the generic repeating-object parser for unionAll, so an explicitly present empty JSON array became the same dataclass default as an omitted unionAll field.
issues.resolution: Parser now requires present select.unionAll to contain at least one JSON object; ViewDefinition.from_dict() inherits the same strict boundary.
